messages:
maria_dev: Heads-up: prototype for 'scope expression' composer landed on the branch. Trying to align it with routing/quota controls.

sam_ops: saw the PR, quick skim. curious how this will work with existing route affinity rules.

taylor_pm: @maria_dev can you post a short example of how an admin would grant a tenant access to a Gaussian routing policy but not allow quota edits?

maria_dev: sure, example below:
```
role: routing_admin
scope:
  allow: ["routes:gaussian:*"]
  deny: ["quota:modify"]
policies:
  - route: gaussian-v2
    weight: 80
    fallback: gaussian-v1
```

lee_eng_platform: That layout seems fine, but curious about UX: will admins see a live preview of effective routes when composing scope expressions? We had confusion on canaries last quarter.

maria_dev: goal is live preview + telemetry links. composer will show 'effective routes' and a count of impacted tenants. clicking the telemetry icon opens the console dashboard filtered by the routes in the expression.

nika_privsec: security note: we need to ensure scope expressions never leak tenant IDs in the preview for cross-tenant admins. Masking needed.

maria_dev: agreed. preview will show counts and anonymous sample ids, not full tenant names. also add audit binding: `composer -> applied by -> policy-id` so every change is auditable.

taylor_pm: product question: for enterprise customers with delegated admin, we should have a toggle: 'allow policy composition' vs 'assign-only'. Many CISOs prefer templates only.

sam_ops: also consider API parity: non-console flows (CLI) will need the same composer validation rules. We must centralize validation in the permission service.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch feature/scope-composer -> staging at 2026-03-18T08:14:03Z :construction:

lee_eng_platform: runtime-wise, when evaluating request routing we need fast-matching of scope expressions. Recommend pre-compile expressions to a trie at policy-rollout time, not at request time.

maria_dev: noted. I'll add a precompile step + metrics around compile time. will also emit a 'compile_fail' event to telemetry if an expression is ambiguous.

nika_privsec: one more: add a 'preview dry-run' audit that simulates request routing for N sample requests and writes to secure logs for compliance.

taylor_pm: sounds good. next step: @lee_eng_platform and @maria_dev to sync on precompile design, I'll draft a small product PR with the enterprise toggle language.

maria_dev: SG. scheduling 30m tomorrow. thanks all :thumbsup:
